exposure: B-lynch approach for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
Endovascular balloon catheter approach for PAS
outcome: Number of packed red blood cell units administered
cohort: Women with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent elective cesarean section at 35-37 weeks of gestation
finding: The endovascular balloon catheter technique for managing placenta accreta spectrum was associated with a lower cesarean hysterectomy rate, less blood loss, and a higher postoperative hemoglobin level compared to the B-lynch approach.
